pairs: Jesus again spoke to them in parables,
Simile factum est regnum cælorum homini regi,
“The kingdom of heaven is like a man who was king,
who celebrated a wedding for his son.
Et misit servos suos vocare invitatos ad nuptias,
And he sent his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding.
But they were not willing to come.
Behold, I have prepared my meal.
tauri mei et altilia occisa sunt,
My bulls and fatlings have been killed,
Yet truly, the rest took hold of his servants and,
having treated them with contempt, killed them.
But when the king heard this,
Then he said to his servants:
sed qui invitati erant, non fuerunt digni:
But those who were invited were not worthy.
and call whomever you will find to the wedding.’
Et egressi servi ejus in vias,
gathered all those whom they found,
and the wedding was filled with guests.
Intravit autem rex ut videret discumbentes,
Then the king entered to see the guests.
et vidit ibi hominem non vestitum veste nuptiali.
And he saw a man there who was not clothed in a wedding garment.
quomodo huc intrasti non habens vestem nuptialem?
how is it that you have entered here without having a wedding garment?’
Then the king said to the ministers:
and cast him into the outer darkness,
ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
consilium inierunt ut caperent eum in sermone.
took counsel as to how they might entrap him in speech.
Et mittunt ei discipulos suos cum Herodianis,
And they sent their disciples to him, with the Herodians,
we know that you are truthful,
et viam Dei in veritate doces,
and that you teach the way of God in truth,
et non est tibi cura de aliquo:
and that the influence of others is nothing to you.
For you do not consider the reputation of men.
dic ergo nobis quid tibi videtur,
Therefore, tell us, how does it seem to you?
Is it lawful to pay the census tax to Caesar,
Show me the coin of the census tax.”
And they offered him a denarius.
Reddite ergo quæ sunt Cæsaris, Cæsari:
“Then render to Caesar what is of Caesar;
and to God what is of God.”
And having left him behind, they went away.
In illo die accesserunt ad eum sadducæi,
who say there is to be no resurrection, approached him.
Si quis mortuus fuerit non habens filium,
If anyone will have died, having no son,
ut ducat frater ejus uxorem illius, et suscitet semen fratri suo.
his brother shall marry his wife, and he shall raise up offspring to his brother.
Erant autem apud nos septem fratres:
Now there were seven brothers with us.
he left his wife to his brother:
and the third, even to the seventh.
In resurrectione ergo cujus erit de septem uxor?
In the resurrection, then, whose wife of the seven will she be?
But Jesus responded to them by saying:
“You have gone astray by knowing neither the Scriptures,
For in the resurrection, they shall neither marry,
sed erunt sicut angeli Dei in cælo.
Instead, they shall be like the Angels of God in heaven.
De resurrectione autem mortuorum non legistis quod dictum est a Deo dicente vobis:
But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken by God, saying to you:
He is not the God of the dead,
And when the crowds heard this,
Pharisæi autem audientes quod silentium imposuisset sadducæis,
But the Pharisees, hearing that he had caused the Sadducees to be silent,
et interrogavit eum unus ex eis legis doctor,
And one of them, a doctor of the law, questioned him,
quod est mandatum magnum in lege?
which is the great commandment in the law?”
Diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo,
“‘You shall love the Lord your God from all your heart,
But the second is similar to it:
‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
In his duobus mandatis universa lex pendet,
On these two commandments the entire law depends,
Then, when the Pharisees were gathered together,
“What do you think about the Christ?
Quomodo ergo David in spiritu vocat eum Dominum,
“Then how can David, in the Spirit, call him Lord,
donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum?
until I make your enemies your footstool?’
Si ergo David vocat eum Dominum,
So then, if David calls him Lord,
how can he be his son?”
Et nemo poterat ei respondere verbum:
And no one was able to respond to him a word.
neque ausus fuit quisquam ex illa die eum amplius interrogare.
And neither did anyone dare, from that day forward, to question him.
